mentions.h: Bels. fifth in National C.C. Relay

photos.c: In the finishing straight,Justin Chaston(5) just fails to catch M.Hawkins(E.C.C.U)but beats K.Lamb(Derby),S.Fielding(E.C.C.U)and M.Flint(E.C.C.U).A great run by our leading Junior.
